description: Election Commission - S. M. Jayasundara was selected as the member of the Ampara Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Ampara Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. The content is directly related to electoral processes at the local government level, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
